subject: Sealed Retail Lab — site compatibility & maintenance window options
messages:
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@retaillab.com>, Onsite Ops <ops@retaillab.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-06T15:12:00Z
Subject: Sealed Retail Lab — site compatibility & maintenance window options

Alex / Team — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Goal: Evaluate an on-prem, air-gapped Private deployment for RetailLab’s in-store ML inference (peak inference for checkout/analytics).
- Primary constraints called out: no external egress, strict maintenance windows (overnight local time only), spare-parts on-site, and quarterly offline security upgrades.
- Preferred target: Private (appliance/VPC with sealed network). Dedicated only acceptable if we can guarantee physical isolation and local-only networking. Hosted API is off the table for the mid-term due to data residency/egress rules.

Immediate asks we left the call with:
1) Site floorplan + rack elevation PDFs for the 2 candidate stores (we asked for 42U availability).
2) Current hardware inventory (GPUs/servers, PSUs, spare parts) so we can validate thermal and power needs.
3) Maintenance window cadence and who the on-site contact is for on-call escalations.

Action items (who/when):
- RetailLab: share floorplan + hw snapshot by EOD Monday (Alex).
- Redwood: Soojin & I will put together a short ops compatibility checklist and a proposed offline upgrade cadence for review (by Wednesday).

I'm attaching the call recording and a quick checklist stub. If RetailLab can confirm the rack availability and whether hostnames are NAT-only (no DNS to public), we can draft hardware sizing and a proposed maintenance playbook.

Thanks — jasmine

Attachments: call_recording_20270606.mp3 (audio), ops_compatibility_checklist_stub.txt (inline stub)

From: Alex Chen <alex@retaillab.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Onsite Ops <ops@retaillab.com>, procurement@retaillab.com
Date: 2027-06-06T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Sealed Retail Lab — site compatibility & maintenance window options

Thanks Jasmine — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We'll prioritize the two stores you saw on the floorplan (Store 7 & Store 12). We have a single 42U rack available in each site; power is 3-phase, PDUs per rack.
- We must keep the environment completely air-gapped — no outbound TLS allowed except for a controlled ops pipe during scheduled maintenance windows that we'll open via jumpbox.
- Upgrade expectations: we want a process that allows us to apply security patches quarterly without taking customer-facing inference offline. Is there a supported hot-swap/rolling update approach for the appliance?
- Spare parts: we keep 1x GPU spare and 1x PSU spare per site. Can Redwood confirm minimum spare inventory recommendations?

Also, can you provide a short list of pre-approved maintenance time windows? We prefer 01:00–03:00 local time, Tuesdays or Sundays. Procurement asked that pricing and MOP (Method of Procedure) be shared to evaluate logistics.

Regards,
Alex
Head of Infrastructure — RetailLab

Onsite contact: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@retaillab.com>

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T09:20:00Z
Subject: RE: Sealed Retail Lab — site compatibility & maintenance window options

Looping in Marissa for visibility on an enterprise procurement ask (pricing/MOP). Quick internal notes: 

- On hot-swap/rolling updates: Soojin — can you confirm whether our appliance supports online kernel-level security updates with incremental container restarts, or do we require a short token-based outage? We should frame both options for Alex (rolling vs scheduled brief outage).
- Spare parts recommendation (initial): 1x spare GPU, 1x spare PSU, 2x spare NVMe per site; this covers N+1 for single-host scenarios. Confirm with HW team.
- Power/thermal: ask site to confirm rack PDU model and available amperage. If PDUs are limited, we may recommend power-distribution adjustments or a staggered boot policy.

Next steps for sales deck: include a short MOP sample for a quarterly security patch and a slide on 'offline upgrade playbook' so procurement sees process. Jasmine — I can draft pricing bands for Dedicated vs Private appliance by EOD Tuesday once we have the floorplan + hw snapshot.

- Ben

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@retaillab.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@retaillab.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-08T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Sealed Retail Lab — site compatibility & maintenance window options

Alex / Maria — great, thanks for the detail. We're aligned on the requirements. Short answers and next steps: 

- Maintenance windows: we support both rolling updates (preferred) and scheduled short outages. For fully air-gapped installs we typically recommend a rolling update model that restarts service containers one at a time; expected customer-facing latency impact is negligible if we stagger restarts and pre-warm model caches. We'll include both options in the MOP.
- Spare parts: our recommended baseline is the same as Ben suggested: 1x GPU, 1x PSU, 2x NVMe per site. We'll add optional onsite spares (additional GPU) for higher availability.
- Power/thermal: please send PDU make/model and amperage per PDU. If unavailable, tell us rack power per-phase and we can advise.

Attachments I'm sending now: site_floorplan_v2.pdf (annotated with suggested rack placement), hw_inventory_snapshot.csv (format example). Please attach your actual floorplans and inventory if available.

Proposed immediate timeline:
- By EOD Monday (2027-06-13): RetailLab sends floorplans + hw inventory.
- By Wednesday (2027-06-15): Redwood returns a preliminary ops compatibility report and a draft MOP for quarterly security patches.
- Week of 2027-06-21: optional remote scoping call with Soojin (ops) and a brief on-site walk if RetailLab prefers.

Can Maria be the day-to-day on-site contact for scheduling? If yes, Maria please confirm and share a mobile for escalation.

Thanks — jasmine
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: site_floorplan_v2.pdf (annotated), hw_inventory_snapshot.csv (schema sample)
